    YEAR

      AGE(
        p.initdate, 
        CURRENT_DATE

parts.text:
Here is the SQL query to calculate the degradation rate for solar panels, including panel ID, fill factor, years since setup, and the rate:

```sql
SELECT
  pa.panemark AS panel_id,
  e.ffactorcurr AS fill_factor,
  EXTRACT(
    YEAR
    FROM
      AGE(
        pl.initdate,
        CURRENT_DATE
      )
  ) AS years_since_setup,
  pe.efficiency_profile -> 'degradation' ->> 'anndegrate' AS degradation_rate
FROM
  plant pl
  JOIN panel pa ON pl.growregistry = pa.hubregistry
  JOIN electrical e ON pa.panemark = e.engyunitref
  JOIN performance pe ON e.efflogref = pe.perfregistry;
```

This query joins the necessary tables and extracts the required fields to calculate the degradation rate for each solar panel. The result includes the panel ID, current fill factor, years since the panel was set up, and the annual degradation rate.
